newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar eases in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar eases in thin trade.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures eased in a slow start to trade on Tuesday, with just 34 lots changing hands by 1010 GMT.
They were all on front month August, which last traded 60 cents lower at $323.00.
Prices were helped down by a small volume of producer selling, one trader said. But he described the market as featureless and expected New York to open unchanged.
On Monday, New York futures closed down and near session lows in thin and rangebound trade, floor sources said.
